hints.title: Permutation Disjoint Cycle Decomposition
hints.text: Every element in a permutation belongs to exactly one disjoint directed cycle.

hints.title: In-Place Visited Node Marking
hints.text: Once a cycle is traversed, mark all visited elements with a sentinel like negative one to prevent traversing the same cycle multiple times.

hints.title: Linear Cycle Traversal and Measurement
hints.text: Loop through indices. If nums[i] is non-negative, follow the cycle pointers, count nodes, and mark visited nodes as negative one. Update maximum cycle length.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-traversing cycles from each starting point takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mutating elements to negative one tracks visited status in-place with strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that permutations decompose into disjoint cycles, so each node is visited at most once.
